sections.heading: To Prepare
items: pat chicken pieces in almonds til coated on each side
deep fry in hot oil til golden brown

sections.heading: Note
items: This appetizer can also be made with sliced walnuts or with light sesame seeds.

sections.heading: Meat
items: Cut 1 LB pork into thin strips and marinate in the following:

sections.heading: Shrimp
items: Marinate 1 cup of small fresh cut up shrimp in the following:

sections.heading: Seasoning
items: 1 TBS cornstarch mixed with 2 TBS water

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Heat 3 TBS oil in the wok. Stir fry the pork about 1/2 minute then drain and set aside. Now stir fry the shrimp in the same oil, drain and set aside also.
Heat 2 TBS oil and brown the scallion and ginger then add the vegetables and stir fry for a short time. Add the shrimp and meat to the wok.
Add the seasonings and cook for a short time.
Remove the filling mixture from the wok and let cool. Roll small [amounts?] of the filling into eggroll skins and deep fry in hot oil at 350 degrees until golden brown. Serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 loaf thin sliced bread, cut into fourths diagonally

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Finely chop and mix the shrimp spread together until the mixture becomes a fine paste.
Spread 2 TBS of the shrimp paste over the bread on 1 side and top with sprinkled topping. Be sure to press the topping sprinkles into the paste a little to keep them on.

Deep fry the shrimp toast in hot oil putting the shrimp side down first until fried a light brown color. Turn them over to fry the unspread side for 1 minute and then serve hot with mustard sauce or duck sauce.
You may freeze the shrimp toast after you have fried them light brown. Simply remove them from the freezer and fry for a short time before serving.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut chicken into 3 inch long strips. Marinate them for 10 minutes.
Deep fry the chicken strips after they have been coated with batter mix until light golden brown.
Serve as an appetizer with duck sauce for dipping.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Use a rolling pin to roll each slice paper thin.
Spread mixture on the bread and roll tight, roll like shape of finger.
Heat oil to medium heat. Deep fry fingers until golden brown and crispy. Serve with soy sauce.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Mix ground pork and fish together and marinate in sauce A for 10 minutes. Add sauce B and mix well.
Place 1/2 cup stuffing into the bean curd skins and roll up. Deep fry in medium oil until crispy and golden. Heat for five minutes and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Mix the hot water and the flour with a wood stick until evenly mixed. Add a little cold water and work the dough into a smooth ball. Let it rest undisturbed for a half hour.
Divide the dough into 20 pieces and roll each into a 5 inch diameter circle. Put about 2 TBS of stuffing mix in the center of the dough circles and shape into a miniature pie.
Use enough oil to just cover the bottom of a flat pan. Using low heat, pan fry both sides of the pies until light brown.
Serve hot with soy sauce and chili sauce to taste.

sections.heading: Stuffing
items: 1 pkg bean thread noodles (soaked and chopped)

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Add the water to the flour and knead the dough until it is smooth. Let it set for at least 15 minutes.
Mix the stuffing ingredients together then add the seasoning mixture. Mix in one direction until it becomes a very smooth paste.
Divide the dough and roll into 3 inch circles. Place 1 TBS of stuffing in the center and shape into a rectangle. Set it on a tray and let it set.

Fill a large pot 70% full of water, bring to a boil, and add about 20 to 30 dumplings. After you bring it to a boil again, add 1 cup of cold water and bring it to a boil again. Repeat this process 3 times and serve hot.
Serve with garlic soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame seed oil.

sections.heading: Ingredients for Filling
items: 1 lb ground beef, pork, veal or chicken

sections.heading: To Prepare Filling
items: Sprinkle 1/2 tsp salt over the cabbage and let it stand for 5 minutes. Then squeeze the cabbage dry with your hands.
Mix the meat, cabbage and all the seasonings together.
To make the dumplings, place 1 TBS filling onto a 3 inch section of dough and crimp the edge.

sections.heading: Boiled Dumplings
items: Boil 2 quarts of water in the wok and drop the dumplings one by one into the water, stirring carefully until the water boils again. Pour 1/3 cup cold water into the wok and when it boils up add 1/3 cup more of cold water. When the water reaches a boil again the dumplings are done. Serve hot.

sections.heading: Steamed Dumplings
items: Place dumplings in the bamboo steamer with wet cheese cloth and steam for 20 minutes or more.

sections.heading: Pan Fried Dumplings
items: Seasoning: 2/3 cup hot water, 1 tsp sesame oil.

Heat a frying pan until very hot and add 2 TBS oil. When oil is hot put in enough dumplings to cover the bottom of the pan. Fry until the bottom is golden. Add seasoning, cover and cook until the liquid has evaporated (about 3-4 minutes). Add 1 TBS oil to side of pan and fry another minute.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut shrimp into 1/4 inch cubes. Marinate in sauce A for 10 minutes.
Mix with bamboo shoots and water chestnuts.
Divide dough into 50 small balls. Press with tortilla press.
Put 1 tsp. stuffing in and make dumpling.
Steam dumplings for 10 minutes and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Clean the fish thoroughly, dry it, cleave it and marinate it for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle cornstarch over the fish and deep fry it until crispy. Set the fish aside.

In the wok use 2 TBS oil to brown Mixture A until the flavor comes out. Add Mixture B, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add Mixture C to the wok and heat and stir until the sauce becomes smooth. Pour it over the fish on a platter and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cook 6 2-inch square pieces of bean curd in boiling water containing 1 tsp salt.
After the bean curd cools, cut each piece diagonally both ways to form 4 triangular pieces.
Now cut each triangle half way through like a pouch and then stuff the slit with the filling. Dust the bean curd with flour.
Fry the bean curd in 2/3 cup oil with the stuffed edge down until it is browned. Add 1 & 1/2 cup soup stock, cover and let simmer at medium heat for 3-4 minutes.
Remove the bean curd to a serving platter.
To the soup, add 2 TBS oyster sauce or soy sauce, 1/2 tsp sugar, MSG, and thicken with 1 TBS cornstarch. Add 1/4 cup shredded scallion and pour the mixture over the bean curd and serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 4 fresh bean curd cakes, cut into 1/4 inch cubes

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Use 2 TBS oil to stir fry the meat until brown. Add mixture A and brown together.
Add mixture B and the bean curd, cover the wok and cook at medium heat for a while until the sauce has reduced to about 1/3 cup.
Add the chopped scallion and mixture C, cook momentarily and pour on a serving platter. Sprinkle the peppercorn salt over the top for better flavor and then serve immediately.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 4 pieces of boneless breast of chicken (or 1 LB round steak)
4-8 dry chili peppers (or 1 tsp crushed red pepper)
1 large green pepper, chopped into 1/2 inch squares (or green beans, zucchini, or asparagus)

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut the meat into 1/2 inch squares and marinate in 1 TBS dark soy sauce and 1 TBS cornstarch for about 30 minutes.
Heat 1 cup of oil in the wok (or frying pan). When the oil is hot, quickly stir fry the chicken (about 1/2 minute). Drain the chicken and set it aside. Empty the oil from the wok.

Heat the wok with 2 TBS of cooking oil in it. When very hot, brown the chili peppers. Add the chopped ginger and vegetable and stir fry until the flavor comes out. Add the chicken to the wok and stir together. Add the sauce mixture and the peanuts, cook momentarily and serve hot.

sections.heading: Notes
items: This dish originates in the Sze-Chuan province in China which is known for its hot and spicy food. Hence, the peppers are an integral part of the dish.
Try to cut the meat and the vegetable a uniform size which makes the dish pleasing to the eye.
The hotter the pan, the faster you can cook the dish, the better it tastes. A cast iron wok seems to work best since it gets very hot and gives the dish a good flavor.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut the flank steak across the grain into wide strips about 1 1/2 inches and skewer the strips of steak on bamboo stick (about 6-7 inch).
Marinate the steak in the sauce mixture overnight or more than 4 hours.
Cook over a hot charcoal fire until cooked.

sections.heading: Note
items: This recipe should only be used as a guide for you as it is important to see Jeanne prepare because of the unique style and skill involved.

sections.heading: Meat and Seasoning for Barbecue Pork Filling
items: 1/2 LB Chinese barbecue pork, cut up into 1/2 inch squares
In a sauce pan, warm all the ingredients together over low heat, until the sauce becomes thick. Add the meat, mix well, and set aside.

sections.heading: Meat and Vegetable Filling
items: 1/2 LB ground pork, beef, or chicken, cubed
1 LB chopped Chinese cabbage, Romain lettuce, or mustard greens
Sprinkle 2 tsp salt over the vegetable and let it stand for 10 minutes. Squeeze the water away with your hand, add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.

sections.heading: For Sweet Dough
items: 1 1/4 cup warm water (mix to dissolve yeast)
2 tsp baking powder (dissolve in 1/2 TBS water)
1 TBS baking soda (dissolve in 1 TBS water)

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Knead the dough and cut it into 20 small pieces. Flatten each piece and roll into 3 inch diameter pancakes, keeping the center of the pancake thicker. Put 1-1 1/2 TBS filling in the center of each pancake and form pleats such that the edge comes up to the top and center.
Place the buns in the steamer for 20 minutes to rise and then steam them over boiling water for 15-20 minutes. Serve hot.

sections.heading: Note
items: The Sweet Dough ingredients are crossed out in the original recipe card; Plain Dough appears to have been used instead.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Mix stuffing and chill in the refrigerator.
Make dough and set it aside to rest about 15 min.
Divide dough into 36 pieces. Roll each piece out into a 3 inch circle and put 1 TB filling and shape into bun.
In a large fry pan, heat 4 TB oil over low heat. Fry buns until they are a light golden color. Add 1 C hot water, cover and let cook until water is gone. Remove cover and serve hot.
